profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Twilio
profile.summary: Specialties: Perl, Go, Backend, Email, Kubernetes

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of EP Core team, worked on design and implementation of Inbound Parse, as well as bounce email flow. 

General architecture of mail flow and optimizing infrastructure utilizing AWS/Kubernetes is also part of the responsibility.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker Products · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Go · Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Terraform · Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) · Email · Software Design · Infrastructure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Utilized Go, Perl, Python, Kafka, Consul, Buildkite, AWS, Chef, Ruby, Kubernates, Docker, and many other tools.  

As part of Core Platform team, designed, implemented and maintained several projects including:
* AWS-backed Gateway for API's and other customer-facing traffic which utilizes JWT for authorization
* Kafka and Ceph to support SendGrid Twilio's email volume which handles more than 6 billion email a day
* Syslog/Kafka-based logging tool that handles SendGrid's eventing system with 30 billions events a day.
* SAML-based SSO authentication
* Hierarchical, distributed scheduler that could stores and queues SendGrid's massive mail traffic backed by Kafka and S3.  (Pending patent listed below).

As part of Core Mail Pipeline team, maintained and implemented new features in core mail pipeline. Major projects include:
* Implemented and maintained API conversions which involves MIME Parsing and SMTP to HTTP conversion
* Internal tools including a new logging library backed by Kafka, testing tools that simulates network failures
positions.insights: Skills: Docker Products · Go · Kubernetes · Terraform

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and added various features to Ticketmaster website, focusing on the checkout component.  Primarily worked with Perl / mod_perl / Apache stack.
- Vouchers as Method of Payment
- ETicket project
- Offering engine
- Ticket Transfer project
- Facility fee custom labeling

As a primary backend engineer in the checkout team, coordinated with various service providers and designed API together on SOA infrastructure transition.
- Built and maintained Resale - checkout component.
- Built and maintained Concerts web client
- Built a dedicated polling service using Node.js

positions.title: Program Analyst
positions.description:
Maintained and created internal business applications using Perl and MySQL
- Automated report generation, reporting tools
- Automated data transfer and aggregation
- Automated letter generation
- Various business applications to help automate certain business flows

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Maintained and managed backend traffic; bot detection through click log analysis and scoring system.

projects.title: Bloomcache
projects.description: A simple cache service backed by bloom filter

patents.title: Hierarchical scheduler
patents.description: Methods, systems, and computer programs are directed to the implementation of configurable hierarchical schedulers with multiple levels, where each level may use one of several types of queueing mechanisms. A configurable, hierarchical scheduler is designed to handle large scale processing of requests (e.g., transmitting outgoing messages)
